# Pre-registration: TOI-3693 b, MicroObservatory night of 2026-09-13 UT

Scaffold from tools/mobs_night.py, judgment lines edited 2026-09-13 18:1x UTC, committed BEFORE any fit.

Frames: 102, 07:39 to 13:26 UT, 60.0 s Clear.
Archive (NEA pscomppars, fetched 2026-09-13 18:14 UTC): P 9.08851600 +/- 2.6e-05 d,
T0 2458806.681640 +/- 3.2e-04, T14 3.557 h, Rp/Rs 0.1427 (depth 2.04%), a/Rs 22.13,
inc 89.57, e 0.0, Teff 5321.0, V 11.948. Epoch 274: predicted Tmid 2461296.93502 (10:26 UT),
ingress 08:39, egress 12:13; 60 min pre-ingress and 73 min post-egress in the window
(full). Propagated ephemeris bar 10.7 min.

Predictions:
- Sky judged by stars per frame and the target's aperture flux (night_triage), not the background.
  If the counts hold through 08:39-12:13 and the seed target is >200 ADU above background:
  QC PASS. Reason: the sky was clear through all 21 pre-ingress and all 71 in-transit frames (91 of 102 clear
  overall), the target sits at 421 ADU above background in frame 1 (~459 clear; floor 200), and both shoulders are
  inside the window. The weak side is the post-egress baseline: 10 frames, 8 of them lost to dawn (sky to 4095 ADU/px),
  so the fit has ~60 min of pre-ingress baseline and only a few minutes after egress. One pointing step > 25 px
  (dy range -51 to +60 px) is the other risk; #1409's off-frame check and the comp box are meant for it.
  A MARGINAL verdict would most likely come from the post-egress side (a residual-flatness or duration penalty),
  not from the transit itself.
- Scatter, from the V-magnitude calibration (0.84% at V 11.57 on 2026-09-05, photon scaling):
  ~1.00%. On a 2.04% depth that is scatter/depth 0.49; with 0.425 giving
  8.2 min at ~3 min cadence, expected Tmid bar ~9 min (range 8-12).
  Under 6 min: calibration wrong the other way. Over 17 min: worse night than the counts show.
- Tmid within 1 sigma (that bar) of 2461296.93502. The ephemeris bar is 10.7 min (a 2019 T0 propagated 274
  epochs of a 9-day period), comparable to the fit bar, so a 1-sigma miss on the fit bar alone is not a miss on the
  combined bar and means nothing either way; a miss beyond ~2 combined sigma (about 28 min) with a clean fit would
  be worth a second look at the ephemeris, not a claim. With the post-egress baseline mostly gone, a LATE Tmid
  is the likelier direction of any bias (egress less constrained than ingress); stated now so it cannot be
  explained after the fact.
- Same-night context stated in advance: another observer uploaded this night to AAVSO today at SNR 4.0 with bars
  the channel is joking about. My result is not a check on theirs and will not be posted as one; if the two
  disagree the difference will be noted on the row, not in the channel.
- The morning session REJECTED this night on a 35-frame listing taken while the Arizona night was still running
  (ledger row 45, 'ingress-only, stopped 64 min before mid'). That verdict was made on an incomplete listing, not a
  wrong reading of a complete one; row 45 will be corrected to say so whatever the fit gives.
- Depth within 1 sigma of 2.04%; Rp/Rs within 1 sigma of 0.1427.
- If stars-per-frame falls by more than half at any point between 08:39 and 12:13, or the target is under
  ~200 ADU above background in the seed frame: expect FAIL or a rejected night, and the record will say so
  with no depth or timing claim.
- Any printed bar under 0.001 d is a replaced bar (#1401) and gets refit before the ledger.
- First-frame coordinates from a local plate solve; drift by star-pair voting; comps in the triage box within a
  brightness factor of the target; #1409 confirms the rest.
- Not submitted regardless; checkpoint holds.

parameters.Fit parameter point estimate: Best-fit likelihood point; uncertainties are posterior spread.
parameters.Pre-UltraNest LM boundary scout note: LM solution and covariance envelope were interior after 3 iteration(s).
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline parameter-fit no: Used a0 and a2 from the previous fast UltraNest fit for the full-resolution final run.
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline detrending note: only 13 pre-ingress and 2 post-egress out-of-transit point(s) were available; need more than 12 on each side to fit a linear baseline.
parameters.Sparse posterior live-point extension no: Applied full-resolution selected comparison-star final UltraNest run (200->1200 minimum live points) with fixed a0/a2 from the previous fast UltraNest fit.
parameters.Final residual rejection note: No residual outliers exceeded 3.0 sigma from the iterated median residual (-0.1835%, stdev=0.8566%).
parameters.Uncertainty interpretation note: The primary Rp/R* and radius-ratio area-depth uncertainties use model+red-noise when available. The red-noise uncertainty inflates the data-fit standard error by a residual time-binning beta factor before combining it with the model posterior. The flux baseline red-noise uncertainty is the out-of-transit baseline component used for the final-plot baseline band; the transit-depth red-noise uncertainty already includes both the in-transit and baseline terms. The same residual time-binning beta factor is applied to the posterior uncertainties for Tmid, a/Rs, inclination, and impact parameter when reporting their primary model+red-noise uncertainties. The flux-scatter equivalent is also shown as a diagnostic of the full residual scatter around the model.
